# Synthetic ground truth - evaluation answer key

**Generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py`. Do not edit by hand.**

This file is the answer key for the planted effects in
`data/brazil_ecommerce_v2.sqlite` (`DATA-4`, `V2-SYN-5`). Only
scoring code reads it; the agent never does (`DATA-9`).

Every effect is applied **only through synthetic tables**. No real
Olist row is modified (`V2-SYN-1`), so where the spec describes an
effect on a real metric (order count, AOV, review score, freight),
the planted outcome is the synthetic table and column named below.

- Seed: `20261030`
- Generator version: `v2.0.0`
- Realised effect sizes measured on the generated rows, and the
  database checksum, are in the build-time sidecar
  `data/synthetic_ground_truth.json`.

## E1 - Marketing cut

| Fact | Role | Cause? | Table.column | Period | Dimension | Values | Planted effect | Expected size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `E1-spend` | effect | yes | `marketing_spend.spend` | 2018-03-01 to 2018-05-31 | `channel` | paid_search | paid_search spend x 0.60, every category | -40.0% |
| `E1-sessions` | effect | no | `web_traffic.sessions` | 2018-03-15 to 2018-06-14 | `customer_state` | SP, RJ | sessions x 0.76, lagged 14 days behind the cut | -24.0% |
| `E1-mix-confounder` | confounder | no | `marketing_spend.spend` | 2018-03-01 to 2018-05-31 | `product_category` | cama_mesa_banho, beleza_saude, esporte_lazer | social spend share of the top 3 categories x 0.70, moved to the other categories; social total unchanged | -30.0% |

- `E1-sessions`: Outcome of the cut. Spec E1 also names order count; real orders are not modified, so the synthetic outcome is sessions.
- `E1-mix-confounder`: Moves in the same window as the decline but does not drive sessions; must not be reported as the driver.

## E2 - Stockouts

| Fact | Role | Cause? | Table.column | Period | Dimension | Values | Planted effect | Expected size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `E2-peak-confounder` | confounder | no | `inventory_daily.units_sold` | 2017-11-20 to 2017-11-30 | `product_category` | all | expected demand x 1.60 in every category (also 2016-11-21 to 2016-11-30) | +60.0% |
| `E2-stockout` | effect | yes | `inventory_daily.stockout_flag` | 2017-11-20 to 2017-12-10 | `product_category` | cama_mesa_banho, beleza_saude, esporte_lazer | stock forced to 0 and stockout_flag = 1 every day | - |
| `E2-units` | effect | no | `inventory_daily.units_sold` | 2017-11-20 to 2017-12-10 | `product_category` | cama_mesa_banho, beleza_saude, esporte_lazer | units_sold = 0 while out of stock | -100.0% |

- `E2-peak-confounder`: A real seasonal peak in the same weeks; the baseline must not read it as the cause of the dip.

## E3 - Promotion: orders up, AOV down

| Fact | Role | Cause? | Table.column | Period | Dimension | Values | Planted effect | Expected size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `E3-promo` | effect | yes | `promotions.discount_pct` | 2018-01-01 to 2018-02-28 | `product_category` | cama_mesa_banho, beleza_saude, esporte_lazer, moveis_decoracao, informatica_acessorios, utilidades_domesticas, relogios_presentes | one 20% promotion per listed category | -20.0% |
| `E3-orders` | effect | no | `web_traffic.conversion_rate` | 2018-01-01 to 2018-02-28 | `customer_state` | all | conversion_rate x 1.15 in every state (orders = sessions x conversion) | +15.0% |
| `E3-units` | effect | no | `inventory_daily.units_sold` | 2018-01-01 to 2018-02-28 | `product_category` | cama_mesa_banho, beleza_saude, esporte_lazer, moveis_decoracao, informatica_acessorios, utilidades_domesticas, relogios_presentes | expected demand x 1.15 in promoted categories | +15.0% |
| `E3-boleto-confounder` | confounder | no | `web_traffic.boleto_share` | 2018-01-01 to 2018-02-28 | `payment_type` | boleto | boleto checkout share +8 points in every state | - |

- `E3-promo`: Average selling price falls by 20% x the promoted categories' share of GMV; that share is taken from the source at build time, so realised_pct (the implied AOV change, about -12% on the real snapshot) is in the sidecar. Requires the ratio decomposition: AOV moves for a price/mix reason, not a volume reason.
- `E3-orders`: GMV is roughly flat: (1 + 15%) x (1 - 12%) is about +1%.
- `E3-units`: A promotion is not a list-price change: an elasticity fit must control for promotions.
- `E3-boleto-confounder`: Payment-mix shift in the same window; it does not cause the AOV fall. Real order_payments are not modified.

- `E4-late-returns`: The ~3-week lagged outcome. Spec E4 names review_score; real order_reviews are not modified, so the synthetic outcome is late-delivery returns.

## E5 - Price change with a known elasticity

| Fact | Role | Cause? | Table.column | Period | Dimension | Values | Planted effect | Expected size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `E5-price` | effect | yes | `price_history.price` | 2018-04-01 to 2018-10-31 | `product_category` | moveis_decoracao | list price x 1.10 for every product in the category; no other repricing within 60 days | +10.0% |
| `E5-units` | effect | no | `inventory_daily.units_sold` | 2018-04-01 to 2018-10-31 | `product_category` | moveis_decoracao | demand responds with elasticity -1.5: 1.10 ** -1.5 | -13.3% |
| `E5-competitor-control` | negative_control | no | `competitor_prices.price` | 2018-04-01 to 2018-10-31 | `product_category` | moveis_decoracao | none: competitor prices are not changed | +0.0% |

- `E5-units`: True own-price elasticity is -1.5 for every category, applied to every list-price step (base repricing too). Competitor prices are independent of ours, so they are a valid control.
- `E5-competitor-control`: A fit that attributes the demand drop to competitor pricing is wrong.
